title: Gowers norm
statement: For natural numbers $n$ and $k$ and a function $f\colon\mathbb{F}_2^n\to\mathbb{R}$, define the Gowers norm of order $k$ by raising the diagonal Gowers inner product of $f$ of order $k$ to the power $1/2^k$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube
